hero.title: Why Study Pharmacy in Germany?
hero.subtitle: Germany offers world-renowned Pharmacy education (Pharmazie) combining pharmaceutical chemistry, pharmacology, and clinical pharmacy at tuition-free public medical faculties.

overview: Germany provides rigorous scientific and clinical training in Pharmacy (Pharmazie), leading to the German State Examination and pharmacist licensure (Approbation) with tuition-free public university options across most federal states.
Edu-Hawk Worldwide Consultancy guides Indian students through German language pathways, university admission criteria, credential evaluation, and student visa processing.
